title: Sausage Peppers and Onions
seoTitle: Sausage Peppers and Onions | Firefighter Meal
subtitle: Sheet-pan Italian comfort
description: Sheet-pan Italian comfort. Sized for a full crew, with timing that still works when the kitchen gets interrupted.
equipment: Large cast iron skillet or Dutch oven

steps.title: Brown sausage links
steps.instruction: Brown Italian sausage in a large skillet over medium-high, turning until all sides color. Slice links on a bias.

steps.title: Sweat peppers and onions
steps.instruction: In the same pan, cook sliced peppers and onions 10–12 minutes until soft with golden edges.

steps.title: Combine and simmer
steps.instruction: Return sausage; add marinara if using. Simmer 5 minutes so flavors meld.

steps.title: Serve on rolls
steps.instruction: Pile sausage and peppers into split hoagie rolls. Sausage Peppers & Onions is a hall classic — keep extra napkins out.

proTips: Keep a backup tray warm in the oven for late calls — nothing worse than cold plates after a run.
Taste for salt at the end — hall palates run salty after long shifts.
tonightSpread: Plate Sausage Peppers and Onions with sides in separate pans so the crew can mix portions.
Line up Sausage Peppers and Onions on the main counter with serving spoons — firefighters grab fast between calls.
Keep a backup tray warm in the oven at 200°F for late arrivals after a run.
leftovers: Cool leftovers in shallow containers within two hours — deep pots stay hot too long.
Label trays with date and reheat to 165°F minimum before second shift.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Sheet-pan Italian comfort. A hall pick for regular dinner nights — one line, real portions, no drama at the stove.
